item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a bar magnet, an iron nail, and a plastic comb. Rohan brings the magnet near each object. The nail is attracted. The comb is not.

Which conclusion is correct?

options.A: The nail is made of a magnetic material; the comb is not.
options.B: The comb is made of a magnetic material; the nail is not.
options.C: Both are magnetic because Rohan used a magnet.
options.D: Both are non-magnetic because only one object moved.
